instruction: Set up VS Code to enable Python linting with pylint and configure the max line length to 100.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to configure Python linting settings. The evaluator checks that 'python.linting.pylintEnabled' is true and 'python.linting.pylintArgs' contains the max line length argument. This is similar to the original task but configures linting instead of diagnostics.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VS Code settings from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Metric check_json_settings properly verifies all expected key-value pairs exist in the settings file
Complete coverage: both requirements verified (python.linting.pylintEnabled=true and python.linting.pylintArgs with max-line-length=100)
Expected values are semantically correct for the task requirements
No state timing issues - VS Code settings are automatically persisted
Logic will work correctly at runtime with proper data flow from getter to metric

metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
